description: This file contains the implementation of a generic grain class 'SimpleGenericGrain<TType>' for Orleans framework, providing basic methods to set, get, transform, and compare grain references.

classes.name: SimpleGenericGrain<TType>
classes.description: A generic grain class implementing ISimpleGenericGrain<TType> providing methods to manipulate and compare grain state and references.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the internal value of the grain.

methods.name: Transform
methods.description: Placeholder method for transforming the grain's state; currently does nothing.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves the current value stored in the grain.

methods.name: CompareGrainReferences
methods.description: Compares the current grain's reference with a client-provided reference to ensure they point to the same grain.
